messages.subject: Regarding Renaming of images
parts:
Dear Team,

I have first-ever tried to use 'camtrapR' to rename my camera trap data. We use a particular format to rename our camera trap images to <GIRD-ID_Place-name_Date_Time>, however with the existing codes, I can rename my data to <GIRD-ID_Date_Time>. Therefore I would like to request you to give me a way to add the 'place name' while renaming the images.

Below I am affirming the codes that I am using for your kind look:

library(camtrapR)
library(exiftoolr)
exiftool_dir <- "C://WINDOWS//exiftool.exe"
setwd("F:/CAMTRPR/")
data <- read.csv("table.csv")
head(data)
wd_image_raw <- "F:/CAMTRPR/RAW IMAGE"
wd_image_renamed <- "F:/CAMTRPR/RAW IMAGE_Renamed"
renamed <- imageRename(inDir = wd_image_raw, outDir = wd_image_renamed, hasCameraFolder = FALSE, copyImages = TRUE)

Regards
Dipankar Lahkar
Aaranyak, India

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Regarding Renaming of images
parts:
Hi Dipankar,
the  current scheme for renaming images is not flexible, since many function in camtrapR expect it to be in a certain format in order to be able to extract information from file names (station and camera IDs, date/time). Hence I can't simply change the renaming scheme without having to rewrite many other functions. 
Currently it allows you to have a hierarchy of Station - Camera in the file names. Any chance you can use that pattern for your Grid - Place Name hierarchy?
Also, what exactly do you mean by grid and place name? With some more details about your study design I might be able to give a better answer on how to make camtrapR work for your case.
Cheers,
Jürgen

messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] Re: Regarding Renaming of images
parts:
Dear Juergen Niedballa,

Thank you very much for your kind response. Now I am clear ab the available functions in camtrapR (Especially the renaming section) and I do expect in the coming days it would be much flexible.

Below, I would like to give you a brief idea about the renaming format of our camera trap image for your better understanding:-

We have been using 4 sq. km grids (each grid has a unique number, e.g. 625, 627, etc.) to guide our camera traps for estimating tigers in Manas National Park located in the sub-Himalayan region in the state of Assam, India since 2010. While renaming, following the unique grid numbers, we concatenate unique area names so that managers can readily identify the locality of the image. e.g. Grid-Number_Area-Name_camera-Side_Date_Time (625_Barbala-River_A_2019-01-19_15-43-38-.jpg)

PS: Attaching a photograph for your reference.


Regards
Dipankar

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] Re: Regarding Renaming of images
parts:
Hi Dipankar, 
and sorry for the late reply. I think the easiest would be to combine the grid and station name into a unique station ID. In your example above, the station could be: "625_Barbala-River". Then you can have your cameras (A) and date/time in the file names as usual. 

Please also note that in imageRename, the station, camera, date and time are separated with double underscores. So if you separate grid and station with a single underscore (for example) you can separate them later if necessary. 

 It is a bit hacky,  but I hope it will work for you. That way it should be compatible with the rest of the camtrapR workflow. I'm sorry, but I can't just easily change the renaming function without lots of unexpected consequences down the road. 
Best,
Jürgen
